result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: an untranslated localization key is shown as a section title on the home feed.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of human-readable text, exposing an internal string identifier to users.
issues.suggestion: Replace the raw key with the correctly localized title (e.g. 'Popular near you'), ensure the translation is present for the current locale, and add a fallback/missing-translation check so unresolved keys are not rendered.
